Google Business Profile setup

Google Business Profile setup, done right the first time

Building your Google Business Profile correctly from day one, for businesses in Denton, Denton County and DFW.

What this is

For most local businesses the profile matters more than the website. It is what appears in Maps, what shows on the right of a search for your name, and what people read before deciding whether to call.

Setting it up is free and takes an hour. Setting it up correctly is the difference between appearing for the searches that bring work and appearing for almost nothing.

What you get

What setup covers

  • 01

    The primary category

    The single heaviest lever in local ranking, and the one most often chosen carelessly. It decides which searches you are eligible to appear for at all, and a near-miss can cost you most of your visibility.

  • 02

    Services and description

    Your services listed individually and a description written within Google's rules. The profile should match what your website says, because contradiction between the two helps nobody.

  • 03

    Service area or address

    Set up correctly for how you actually work. A business that travels to customers is configured differently from one people visit, and getting this wrong is a common cause of suspension.

  • 04

    Hours, attributes and contact details

    Including the details that turn up in filtered searches, which is where a properly completed profile quietly beats a half-finished one.

  • 05

    Photographs

    Real ones, of real work. A profile with no photos looks abandoned, and the pictures are often the only thing a customer actually looks at.

  • 06

    Verification

    Getting through Google's verification, which increasingly means recording a video of your premises, vehicle or equipment. This is the step that surprises people.

What verification involves now

Google has moved much of verification to video. You record a continuous clip showing your equipment, signage or vehicle, the area you work from, and yourself accessing it, proving the business is real and yours.

It can take a few attempts, and rejections are often unexplained. This is the part of setup that takes patience rather than skill, and knowing what the video needs to show saves most of the repetition.

What it costs

This is included in the Plus plan, alongside everything in the tiers below it. Setup is $400 one-time setup fee and the plan runs $40/month. The full breakdown is on the pricing page.

Setup on its own, without a website plan, is quoted after a consult.

How this differs

Setup means there is no profile yet, or it was never claimed. The work is creation and verification. Optimization is for a profile that already exists and needs assessing and repairing, which carries different risks because editing a live listing can trigger review.

Ongoing posts, photos and review replies afterwards are profile management.

Questions

What people ask

Can I do this myself?

Yes, and plenty of owners should. It is free and the interface is not hard. What is worth paying for is the category choice and the service area configuration, which are the two decisions with lasting consequences. If you want to run it yourself properly, that is Google Business Profile training.

I do not have a shop. Can I still have a profile?

Yes. A service-area business hides its address and lists the areas it covers. Configuring that correctly matters, because an address shown when it should be hidden is a common suspension trigger.

How long does verification take?

Anywhere from a couple of days to a few weeks depending on the method and whether the first attempt is accepted. Video verification is faster when you know what it needs to show.

What is the most common setup mistake?

The wrong primary category, followed by keyword-stuffing the business name. The second one feels clever, breaks Google's rules, and is a frequent cause of suspension.
